H4609: elevation, i.e. the act (literally, a journey to a higher place, figuratively, a thought arising), or (concretely) the condition (literally, a step or grademark, figuratively, a superiority of station); specifically a climactic progression (in certain Psalms)
H835: happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H3018: toil; hence, a work, produce, property (as the result of labor)
H3709: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H1612: a vine (as twining), especially the grape
H3411: properly, the flank; but used only figuratively, the rear or recess
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H8363: a sprig (as if transplanted), i.e. sucker
H2132: an olive (as yielding illuminating oil), the tree, the branch or the berry
H5439: (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around
H7979: a table (as spread out); by implication, a meal
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H1288: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
H1397: properly, a valiant man or warrior; generally, a person simply
H6726: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H2898: good (as a noun), in the widest sense, especially goodness (superlative concretely, the best), beauty, gladness, welfare
H3389: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H7965: safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
